claim: Color Status Labeler is for people with color-vision deficiency who need readable dashboard and map statuses.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the first screen names the audience and exposes the sample-data action

claim: Try the sample dispatch board without saving changes as real extension rules.
sandbox: fresh browser context; modify sample data, assert only the demo: storage key exists, reset it, then leave demo mode

claim: The demo links to an installable Chrome extension ZIP.
sandbox: build the archive; unzip and validate manifest.json; load the unpacked package in a fresh Chromium extension profile and inspect chrome.runtime.getManifest()

claim: The content-addressed package URL changes with the extension package, so returning users do not receive an older cached release.
sandbox: fresh browser context; wait for the site worker, seed a stale package at the former fixed download path, then fetch the current content-addressed URL and assert it returns the ZIP

claim: The extension is free to download without a payment step.
sandbox: open /demo; request the direct download link and assert it serves the extension ZIP without a payment route

claim: No account is required and the demo sends no requests to third parties.
where: landing facts, privacy copy, and footer
sandbox: fresh /demo browser context; record requests, cookies, storage, and account-form controls

claim: Export labels as a JSON backup and import a valid backup for the current site.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; seed two local rules, export and parse the downloaded JSON, reject malformed JSON, import one valid rule, and inspect the current-origin storage result

claim: Delete one learned label or clear all labels for a site from the extension popup.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; use the real popup to confirm-delete, undo, confirm-clear, and inspect the saved empty rule list

claim: Status labels do not read password values, submit forms, or change forms, links, and page data.
where: landing feature explanation and privacy page
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile on the sample page; train a rule and assert a normal field, password-value read trap, link href, and form submission count remain unchanged

claim: The extension has no account system, analytics, advertising, telemetry, or remote APIs; it sends no page contents, uses no cookies, and loads no third-party runtime scripts or fonts.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; record every HTTP request while opening the sample and popup, assert only the sample origin, no cookies, no account fields, local extension resources, and no cookie/identity/webRequest permissions

claim: Label recurring color-only statuses with a word and a pattern.
where: landing, demo, README, and extension package
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile on /demo; train the green sample status and observe its badge and legend

claim: Rules stay in Chrome local extension storage.
where: landing facts, privacy page, README, and extension popup
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile on /demo; save a rule and inspect chrome.storage.local for that origin only

claim: Status badges do not block page controls.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile on /demo; inspect the rendered badge pointer-events behavior

claim: Saved rules return on the same site.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile on /demo; save a rule, reload, and observe the restored legend and badge

claim: The sample guide remains available offline after its first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; activate the service worker at /demo, set offline, reload, and assert the sample heading and offline notice
